name: agent-notify
description: Deploy-to-Cloudflare email notifications for your AI agents (HTTP + MCP)

TO_ADDRESS.description: The inbox where alerts go (any provider). Verify it first: [Destination addresses](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/email-service/routing) → add the address → click the link Cloudflare emails you.

FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender, e.g. `alerts@yourdomain.com`. Its domain must be **onboarded for sending** ([Email Sending → Onboard Domain](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/email-service/sending)).

KV.description: Stores your generated access token. Leave the default.

DAILY_LIMIT.description: Max emails per day. The default `100` keeps you within Cloudflare's included quota, so this can never cost money. Leave it unless you need more.
